page: OVHcloud d2-4 is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the Discovery family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 Intel processor based on the Haswell architecture operating at 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 shared vCPUs, 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is provided via a local 50 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface has a baseline bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance consistently in the bottom 10% of performance categories. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests yielded scores of 932.77 and 1818.26 respectively, while the Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores reached 632.0 and 1126.0. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with uncached read and write speeds at 19.19 GB/sec and 14.22 GB/sec respectively. Static web serving throughput is recorded at 1.89 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations achieve 2.07 million operations per second.

Given its shared CPU allocation and low baseline network bandwidth, the d2-4 is designed as a budget-friendly option for non-critical workloads. The primary tradeoff is the constrained processing power and memory throughput, which makes it unsuitable for resource-intensive applications or large-scale LLM inference. It is best utilized for basic development environments, low-traffic static web hosting, lightweight testing, and simple background tasks that do not require sustained high CPU performance.
